solver_visible_problem_statement:
Theme Previewer: Better contrast on the style variations

## Where
In many different onboarding, where we show the theme picker + theme previewer. Example: https://wordpress.com/setup/onboarding, after selecting goals and moving to design selection.

## Problem
Some of these color palettes have pretty bad contrast.


> **视觉材料 1**：见下方对应图片。



## Solution
Designers should revise the suggested style variations and fix those who do not pass a bare minimum of contrast.

human_visual_input_check.boundary: Human selection authorizes test construction only; it does not imply tests_approved, frozen, measured, or Harbor admission.

atomic_visual_constraints.requirement: 样式变体预览中的两个高亮色圆点必须优先呈现正文文字色与按钮背景色（按钮色缺失时回退到链接色），并排除已经作为卡片底色显示的背景色。

atomic_visual_constraints.visual_category: 元素结构与视觉状态理解
atomic_visual_constraints.requirement: 即使候选 palette 中出现重复 slug，两个高亮圆点仍必须稳定渲染且不产生重复 React key 警告。

visual_constraints: 样式变体卡片中的前景圆点与背景必须具有最低可辨识对比度
